title: GEMORO ASSAY LAB XRF Desktop Gold & Precious Metal Analyzer
text: Press Releases GEMORO ASSAY LAB XRF Desktop Gold & Precious Metal Analyzer The ASSAY LAB provides precise percentage readings of different elements including gold, platinum, silver, rhodium, and other precious metals. Published 13 hours ago on January 22, 2026 By Press Releases Share Tweet (PRESS RELEASE) DALLAS, TX — The NEW GEMORO ASSAY LAB has a compact, sleek, ergonomic design that fits comfortably on a desk or counter and has a bright touchscreen and full color display. It is an Energy Dispersive Spectrometer precious metal analyzer, that is proudly made in the USA. It features as standard equipment a premium Silicon Drift Detector (SDD), which is the most advanced and accurate type available. The ASSAY LAB provides precise percentage readings of different elements including gold, platinum, silver, rhodium, and other precious metals. It also has a wide range of standard compositions in its library, allowing you to instantly identify and distinguish between various stainless-steel compositions including 304, 316, and 904L stainless-steel, supporting authentication testing of RLX stainless-steel watches. Easily export date and time stamped test results that can be saved or imported into a printable document. The ASSAY LAB also offers a sophisticated PLATING WARNING detection feature. To order, finance or learn more, contact SY KESSLER / GEMORO at 800.527.0719, [email protected], or visit us online at www.sykessler.com. GEMORO XRF gold and precious metal testing equipment can be ordered from participating Authorized GEMORO Dealers and suppliers of jewelry equipment, including STULLER, Zak Jewelry Tools, Landa / BTI, SEP Tools, Star Struck, Gesswein, and many more.
